goal: Promote Bora's user-tweaked Cable One v2 DOCX to the final human-approved resume presentation reference, add research-backed recruiter/ATS writing constraints that reinforce that artifact, and authorize a bounded Claude-first drafting pilot without changing Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification logic, or building a generator.
acceptance_conditions: the final human-approved reference is identified as Bora_Chaush_Cable_One_Business_Analyst_I_v2(1).docx with SHA-256 236179c98b0e3ef68f7e79e392d73e57db41acb6f8493b0a7ab9eb8b2b353955 and explicitly supersedes Spy Pond only as the latest presentation reference, never as a source of Candidate Truth

the existing hard presentation grammar remains: no generic PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading; EDUCATION then SKILLS then WORK EXPERIENCE then RELEVANT PROJECT; Title | Employer with right-aligned dates; two-school education grammar; three natural skills rows; one page; one column; DOCX-first; real hyperlinks; 92%+ meaningful utilization

human readability outranks keyword density: candidate-facing language is ordinary American English, concrete, direct, and recruiter-natural, with no internal-system jargon, capability stuffing, inflated adjectives, or robotic phrasing
summary is a short natural positioning paragraph that connects current career stage, strongest approved evidence, and target role family; it must not become a keyword inventory

experience and project bullets prefer action plus context plus outcome/value when evidence supports an outcome; when no defensible outcome exists, use action plus context/purpose without inventing impact
bullets are kept concise and scan-friendly, normally one to two rendered lines where practical; relevance and clarity matter more than forcing every bullet to the same length
quantification is used when it materially helps the reader understand scale or result and is supported by approved evidence; numbers are never manufactured merely to make a bullet look stronger

JD terminology may be reused only when the Requirement/EvidenceMatch crosswalk establishes supported overlap; exact employer terms should be distributed naturally across summary, skills, experience, and project evidence rather than repeated for keyword density
skills prioritize role-relevant hard skills and evidence-backed operational capabilities; generic soft-skill filler is excluded unless it is concretely supported by experience evidence
the resume tells one coherent early-career story from education and skills into work evidence and project proof, rather than reading as disconnected keyword blocks
the user-tweaked reference's TELUS display label and GPA presentation are recorded as presentation choices only and may not silently alter underlying Candidate Truth or evidence provenance

a Claude-first drafting pilot is authorized at PRODUCE PACKAGE: Claude receives only the exact verified JD, approved Requirement/EvidenceMatch crosswalk, approved Candidate Truth/evidence modules, and current reference grammar; Claude may draft candidate-facing wording but may not infer facts, tools, metrics, outcomes, or qualification states

G remains responsible for orchestration, truth/evidence adjudication, rejection of unsupported Claude language, final reference-grammar conformance, rendered DOCX QA, hyperlink verification, and the human approval gate
no automated DOCX generator, renderer, schema change, Candidate Truth change, Match Truth change, qualification/pursuit runtime change, or protected resume-master change is introduced
stop_conditions: the calibration would require changing Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/pursuit logic, schemas, or runtime product code
the calibration would weaken truth lineage, first-party job verification, the 92% page-utilization floor, DOCX-first submission, hyperlink-object verification, or rendered-artifact QA
the calibration would turn external resume advice into a rule that conflicts with Bora's explicit human-approved reference or would force invented outcomes/metrics
the Claude drafting pilot would require granting Claude authority to create facts or make consequential pursuit/qualification decisions
research_basis: U.S. Department of Labor VETS Resume Essentials 2026: targeted achievement statements and job-description keyword alignment
University of Pennsylvania Career Services: 1-2 line bullets, action verbs, context/transferable skills/results, consistent readable formatting
Yale Office of Career Strategy: Action + Project + Result / WHO-style bullets, role-relevant accomplishments, simple ATS-friendly formatting
Indeed 2026 ATS guidance: write for both ATS and recruiter/hiring manager; reuse role-specific job-description keywords naturally
LinkedIn Talent Solutions recruiter guidance: strong organization/format, real achievements, and evidence that matches the role
